image_description: A close-up, ground-level shot of several small, pale cream-to-white coral fungi (likely Clavulina cristata or similar) growing from dark soil and leaf litter. The fungi feature upright, cylindrical stems that branch into intricate, club-like tips with a slightly rough, granular texture. The background consists of blurred twigs, dry leaves, and patches of moss.
